title: Count Lines in a Text File
question: Read a text file named notes.txt and print how many lines it contains. Create the file first with at least one line.
code:
with open("notes.txt", "w", encoding="utf-8") as file:
    file.write("First line\nSecond line\nThird line\n")

with open("notes.txt", "r", encoding="utf-8") as file:
    line_count = sum(1 for line in file)

print("Lines:", line_count)
explanation: The with statement closes the file automatically; iterating over a file reads it line by line.
